card.name: Copyright restrictions on reproducing website content
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas inside website copyright notices that list banned actions such as reproduce, copy, sell or distribute. It fires on words like in, any, to and commas within those lists.

modes.label: Commas in action lists
modes.description: Commas between banned verbs such as copy, reproduce, republish, transmit.
modes.example: YOU MANY NOT MODIFY, COPY, REPRODUCE<<,>> REPUBLISH, UPLOAD, POST, TRAN

modes.label: Linking words in usage terms
modes.description: Words like in, any, into or to in phrases about using material in any manner, format or work.
modes.example: no person or organisation is permitted to incorporate any copyright material from this website into<< any>> other work or publication in any format (

card.plain: It marks the legal wording in website copyright notices that forbid copying or reusing the material.
